The issuer generates substantial revenue ($13.1B) and maintains profitability (EBIT of $710M and Net Income of $517M), but operates with high leverage (Total Debt/Liabilities of $13.8B against $3.2B in equity) and a weak liquidity position with a current ratio below 1.0 (Current Assets of $2.57B vs. Current Liabilities of $2.88B). These financial metrics indicate moderate creditworthiness, characteristic of lower-tier investment-grade issuers that possess adequate capacity to meet financial commitments but face heightened vulnerability to adverse economic conditions.

DECISION: BBB-
